# The CRM that sells with you

Calling, email, SMS, automation, and AI are built in, so your team can reach more leads, follow up faster, and close more deals.

or [Sign up with Google](https://app.close.com/signup/oidc-redirect/)

A walkthrough of Close: a new lead, Orbitwell, is enriched by AI and qualified on a call by a Voice Agent, which books a demo and texts the confirmation. The team's Hot Leads list fills in, Chloe answers what to focus on today and builds a Lead Follow-up Agent that, once turned on, shows up running on the Agents list.

## Every conversation makes the next one better.

Every call, text, and email is already part of the record, so your team always knows where things left off. That context carries into the next conversation, whether the same rep picks it back up, someone else does, or an Agent does, so the prospect never has to repeat themselves.

1.  8:47 AM Pipeline
    
    ### Your pipeline, already prioritized
    
    See every deal by stage and value at a glance, with a suggested next step on each one, so you always know which deal to move today.
    
    [Explore the pipeline view](https://close.com/reporting)
    
    The Sales Pipeline in Close: deals land in their stages — Demo Completed, Proposal Sent, Contract Sent — each stage with its count and annualized value. "Needs attention" is switched on, the deals that are fine drop away, and the three left get a follow-up suggestion each: draft an email and schedule a call with Reynolds & Wareham, text Loftwork Studio, call Prestancia Group.
    
2.  9:15 AM Calling, Email, & SMS
    
    ### Contact your priority leads
    
    Open a Smart View, hit dial, and Close moves through the list on its own, connecting you the moment someone picks up. No manual dialing between calls, no losing track of who's next.
    
    [Explore calling, email, & SMS](https://close.com/communication)
    
    The power dialer in Close working through the High Priority Leads list, then the call it connects with Steve Hall of Brightpine Foods: the live transcript lands on the lead record as they talk, and the AI Notetaker writes the notes.
    
3.  10:23 AM AI Notes
    
    ### Never lose the important details
    
    They mention a budget freeze until Q3. Before you've even hung up, it's on the record, even though you didn't stop to write it down. Close captures what's said on every call and meeting, so nothing gets lost waiting to be typed up.
    
    [Explore Calling](https://close.com/calling)
    
    Brightpine Foods' lead record in Close right after the call with Steve Hall: the AI Notetaker's summary lands on the call — highlights, the company and sales motion, their current setup, objections and next steps — with the recording under it.
    
4.  2:30 PM Agents
    
    ### Agents pick up the work
    
    In beta|**Voice agents live now**
    
    Give an Agent a job: draft a follow-up, review the most common reasons deals are lost, keep lead fields up to date. It gets to work and gives you a full overview of what it did.
    
    [Explore Agents](https://close.com/agents)
    
    The Agents page in Close: the Closed-lost Re-engagement Agent runs its weekly job — finds 27 eligible leads, reviews each history, writes 27 re-engagement drafts and creates 3 review tasks — then reports 16 actions, 27 drafts and 3 tasks, with the first three drafts ready to review.
    
5.  5:00 PM Workflows
    
    ### Log off while Close stays late
    
    A new lead comes in at 7 PM on Friday. Your workflow sends the first email, texts on Saturday, and puts a call on your rep's list for Monday morning. Set it up once, and every lead gets the same fast follow-up.
    
    [Explore Workflows](https://close.com/automation)
    
    The High Priority Leads list in Close on a Friday evening: a new lead, Cadencelabs, comes in at 7:02 PM and the After Hours Workflow takes it — a qualifying email now, a follow-up text Saturday at 10 AM, a call task for the lead's owner Monday morning.
    

The Sales Pipeline in Close: deals land in their stages — Demo Completed, Proposal Sent, Contract Sent — each stage with its count and annualized value. "Needs attention" is switched on, the deals that are fine drop away, and the three left get a follow-up suggestion each: draft an email and schedule a call with Reynolds & Wareham, text Loftwork Studio, call Prestancia Group.

## The lead that waits is the lead you lose.

Average lead, still waiting

42:00:00

Your Close lead

00:05:00

Only 7% of companies respond to a new lead within five minutes. The average is over 42 hours. By then, they've already talked to someone else.

Your team doesn't have to be online for Close to respond.

## Agents cover the gaps. Your team closes the deals.

Agents and Chloe already know your leads, conversations, and deals because they’re built into Close. Agents take work off your plate. Chloe helps you get through yours.

[Put AI to work](https://close.com/ai)

Voice Agent· Live now

Coming soon

-   Coaching
-   Briefing
-   Meeting follow-up
-   Lead routing
-   Deal risk
-   Win-back

-   Agents
    
    ### Your Agents work for you.
    
    Give each one a job and your rules. It runs that job on its own, every time, and logs the work in Close.
    
    A Voice Agent in Close picking up a new lead: it calls, qualifies, books the demo, sends the confirmation, updates the record and leaves the rep a follow-up task
    
    1.  Call Calls the lead Reached Maya within 60 seconds 9:02 AM
    2.  Qualify Asks your qualifying questions 12 reps, budget set, buying this quarter 9:06 AM
    3.  Meeting Books the demo With Jordan, Thu 2:00 PM 9:07 AM
    4.  SMS Confirmation text sent Invite and dial-in sent to Maya 9:07 AM
    5.  Record Record and fields updated Status Qualified, team size and budget saved 9:08 AM
    6.  Task Follow-up task created Jordan: review call notes before Thursday 9:08 AM
    7.  Session complete. Jordan has everything for Thursday.
    
-   AI Assistant
    
    ### Chloe works with you.
    
    Ask about your pipeline, meetings or calls. Get answers from your own data, then act on them.
    
    Chloe, the AI Assistant in Close, answering a seller’s questions from their own pipeline, then acting on them
    
    What deals need my attention today?
    
    You
    
    These 3, based on activity in Close:
    
    -   Tidewater Movers · $42k Closes Friday, no touch in 9 days
    -   Brightline Health · $18k Opened your proposal 3x yesterday
    -   Summit Dental · $9.5k Asked for pricing on Tuesday’s call
    
    Chloe
    
    Draft follow-ups for all 3
    
    You
    
    Done: 3 follow-up drafts are ready to review in your inbox.
    
    Want an Agent to flag deals like these every morning?
    
    Chloe
    
    Prep me for my 2:00 with Brightline Health.
    
    You
    
    Here’s what matters from your history:
    
    -   Decision maker · Priya Nair VP Operations, on the last call
    -   Last call · 6 days ago Asked if you support SSO
    -   Open question Annual or monthly billing
    
    Chloe
    
    Add talking points to the meeting
    
    You
    
    Done: Added 4 talking points to your 2:00 with Brightline Health.
    
    Want a Briefing Agent to prep every meeting like this?
    
    Chloe
    
    Summarize my call with Summit Dental.
    
    You
    
    Tuesday’s call, 24 minutes:
    
    -   Need Online booking across 3 locations
    -   Budget · $9.5k Approved by the owner
    -   Next step Send pricing by Thursday
    
    Chloe
    
    Create the task and draft the pricing email
    
    You
    
    Done: Task set for Thursday, and the pricing email is drafted.
    
    Want a Meeting follow-up Agent to do this after every call?
    
    Chloe
